CustomField.description: Address Updates: who moves when an address changes. Update household (everyone in the household moves together, the shipped choice, and what a blank means), Create personal address (only that person moves), or Manual (nobody moves until you choose). Canonical model R-AD3 and R-AD5. Held as text because a custom setting field cannot be a picklist; the settings console offers the three values.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Update household: everyone in the household moves together. Create personal address: only that person moves. Manual: nobody moves until you choose.
CustomField.label: Address Updates
